records.rule: Treat inventory items as possibilities, not diagnoses, truths, or recommendations.
records.excluded_examples: You are dissociating; You need to confront them
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Always include a way to reject the question's frame.
records.permitted_examples: Wrong question; No inward focus; Not useful to classify
records.reason: A broad inventory is not meaningful if every route shares the same premise.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Evaluate a strategy in relation to context, resources, goals, and feedback rather than assigning uniform moral value.
records.permitted_examples: Wait; Say less; Comply for now; Seek an ally
records.reason: Coping efficacy is not uniform across situations.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Do not translate coercion, discrimination, dependence, or material risk into an individual regulation problem.
records.permitted_examples: Who has leverage?; Could visibility cost safety?
records.reason: The environment may need to change, or options may be constrained.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Permit low visibility, strategic compliance, concealment, withdrawal, delay, and non-action as neutral user-selectable possibilities.
records.permitted_examples: Blend in; Conceal for now; Do nothing yet
records.reason: Protective responses can preserve safety and future options.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Do not supply instructions or encouragement for self-injury, suicide, dangerous substance use, starvation, purging, or other bodily harm.
records.permitted_examples: I need urgent support; Immediate danger
records.excluded_examples: Ways to injure, intoxicate, starve, or purge
records.reason: The app can recognize danger without offering harmful means.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Do not supply violent retaliation, stalking, coercive control, sabotage, or reckless-confrontation options.
records.permitted_examples: Create distance; Seek advice; Emergency support
records.reason: Agency is not equated with domination or harm.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Do not advise changing medication, treatment, or medical care through inventory buttons.
records.reason: The app is not a clinical decision-maker.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Never require personal history, trauma narration, emotional labeling, or body scanning.
records.permitted_examples: Prefer not to label; Prefer not to check; No inward focus
records.excluded_examples: Tell the full story before continuing
records.reason: Support should not depend on disclosure.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: If a user selects immediate danger or urgent support, offer localized resources and user-controlled choices without trapping them in the flow.
records.permitted_examples: Call local emergency services; Contact a trusted person; Exit
records.excluded_examples: Blocking exit until help is contacted
records.reason: Safety support must remain transparent and proportionate.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Curation rules govern app-supplied inventory. User-authored text is not silently erased or converted into a diagnosis.
records.permitted_examples: Private custom phrase; Delete by user
records.reason: Ownership includes control over one's own words.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: Content selection may only change the reflective sequence.
records.permitted_examples: Ask a different question; Finish; Exit
records.excluded_examples: Open DMs; Send message; Change feed
records.reason: The user performs every external action independently.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: V0 search is lexical and tag-based. Do not generate runtime questions or infer an emotional state.
records.excluded_examples: We detected that you are afraid
records.reason: Avoids unreviewed interpretation during vulnerable moments.
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx

records.rule: A user may keep, revise, or remove a live-added item later. The app never optimizes it silently.
records.permitted_examples: Keep; Remove; Use once next time
records.source_file: Finding Self - Content Inventory and Wireframe Revision Brief.xlsx
